name: IC Power Switching Regulator — QFN
description: Integrated circuit power switching regulator cluster in surface-mount QFN packaging featuring DHVQFN-16 footprint support for parts such as NBM5100A and NBM7100A.
selection_hints: Select when requiring a switching regulator IC in SMD QFN packaging.
Match board layout to the DHVQFN-16-1EP (2.5x3.5mm, 0.5mm pitch) footprint.
Review representative parts NBM5100A and NBM7100A for application suitability.
avoid_when: Through-hole mounting or package families other than QFN are needed.
The design requires footprints other than DHVQFN-16-1EP_2.5x3.5mm_P0.5mm_EP1x2mm.
Tier A reviewed components are strictly required.
